title: Blueprint verb family
purpose: Cover rcf define blueprint add/list/remove verb family behaviour and the manifest.blueprints[] write path.

testCases.description: add on a clean project writes manifest.blueprints[] and copies namespaced contributions
testCases.testPointer: test/blueprint/apply.test.js::applyBlueprint: writes an entry to manifest.blueprints[] and copies namespaced contributions (AC-1001-1)

testCases.description: list prints applied blueprints in appliedAt order
testCases.testPointer: test/blueprint/list-remove.test.js::listBlueprints: two applied blueprints render in appliedAt order (AC-1001-2)

testCases.description: remove refuses when a project-authored doc references a contribution id
testCases.testPointer: test/blueprint/list-remove.test.js::removeBlueprint: refuses when a project-authored doc references a contribution id (AC-1001-3)

testCases.description: re-apply of same slug+version is a no-op
testCases.testPointer: test/blueprint/apply.test.js::applyBlueprint: idempotent re-apply of the same slug + version returns alreadyApplied and does not rewrite the manifest (AC-1001-4)

testCases.description: rcf --help advertises blueprint as a top-level command
testCases.testPointer: test/blueprint/cli.test.js::rcf --help advertises `blueprint` and `standards` as top-level commands (AC-1001-5)
